channel.title: Rarebird Forecast — TJ
channel.description: Weekly rarity likelihood outlook for TJ

item.title: TJ rarity outlook — 2026-W43
item.description:
1. Мамнӯъгоҳи Табиии Паланг (Tigrovaya Balka Nature Reserve - Restricted access) — index 100
2. Дар Ҷануби Кирпичнӣ (South of Kirpichni) — index 90
3. Панҷакент--соҳили дарёи Зарафшон (Panjakent--Zeravshan River bank) — index 10
4. Ботлоқзори Сурх (Surkh Wetlands) — index 2
5. Сарбандҳои обтозакунии Душанбе (Dushanbe Water Treatment Impoundments) — index 1
Species to watch: Blue-cheeked Bee-eater, Eurasian Curlew, Black Stork, Eurasian Penduline-Tit, Paddyfield Warbler
Likelihood of a rarity report this week. Full map: https://AlphaBetaGammaChi.github.io/rarebird
